items.title: You don't need a transformation. You need one repair.
items.excerpt: Image You don't need a transformation. You need one repair. You've done the big change. Maybe more than once. The reorg, the new framework, the tooling migration, the all-hands where someone put "cultural change" on a slide. Months of disruption, a real budget, everybody's attention. And here you are, hitting the same frictions you started with. The status that stays green until it snaps. The retro that changes nothing. The team that waits more than it works. That isn't bad luck, and it isn't because you picked the wrong framework this time. It's because the unit of change was always too big.
items.titleJa: 大規模な変革は不要、必要なのは小さな改善
items.summaryJa: 組織の大きな変革プロジェクトは多くの場合、元の問題を解決できていません。本記事は、再編成やツール移行などの大規模変更ではなく、変化の単位を小さくし段階的な改善を積み重ねることの重要性を指摘しています。
